name: deckaura-tarot
description: Reflective tarot card lookups and spreads backed by Deckaura's open 78-card dataset.

interface.shortDescription: Reflective readings from an open 78-card dataset.
interface.longDescription: Look up all 78 tarot cards and create daily, three-card, relationship, decision, yes/no, and Celtic Cross readings using Deckaura's versioned open dataset. The plugin runs locally, makes no network requests, and frames readings as reflection rather than factual prediction.
defaultPrompt: Give me a reflective three-card tarot reading.
Explain The Star upright and reversed.
Draw one card as a journaling prompt.
